topic: What the Bitcoin block reward is and how halvings change it
hook: Every four years, Bitcoin miners get a pay cut. On purpose.

scenes.narration: A miner's reward for a block is the subsidy of new bitcoin, plus the transaction fees.
Every 210,000 blocks, roughly four years, the subsidy is cut in half.
At the April 2024 halving it dropped to 3.125 bitcoin per block.

cta: Want to dig deeper? There's a link on my channel page if you'd like to explore digital mining.
title: Bitcoin Halving Explained in 30 Seconds
description_body: The block subsidy halves every 210,000 blocks. Since April 2024 it has been 3.125 BTC per block.
